name: mkeys
description: MyKeys — local-first credential vault for ZCode: manage passwords/keys for various systems, verify logins and issue temporary tokens for AI use, with per-purpose usage statistics.

description_i18n.en: MyKeys — local-first credential vault for ZCode: manage passwords/keys for various systems, verify logins and issue temporary tokens for AI use, with per-purpose usage statistics.
description_i18n.zh-CN: MyKeys — 面向 ZCode 的本地优先凭据保险库：管理各系统的密码与密钥，验证登录并签发供 AI 使用的临时令牌，并按用途统计 AI 使用情况。

allowReveal.title: Allow raw secret reveal / 允许读取原始密钥
allowReveal.description: When enabled, the reveal_secret tool can return decrypted raw field values (every read is audited). Keep disabled if the AI only needs temporary tokens.

allowPrivateEndpoints.title: Allow private network endpoints / 允许内网验证地址
allowPrivateEndpoints.description: verify/token 端点默认只允许公网 http/https 地址（拒绝环回与私有网段，防 SSRF）。仅当你明确需要让 MyKeys 访问内网/本机服务时开启。
